home.lamps/dust_bunny_glow.txt:
i have a dust bunny friend.
he doesn't glow.
but when the sun hits him, he looks golden.
very fluffy.
home.lamps/sleep_mode_dark.txt:
not a lamp.
just the quiet dark.
it's scary but i hum to myself.
home.diary/eating_crumbs.txt:
a crumb fell from above. it was green.
i do not know if it is food. i do not know if it is paint.
i ate it. it tasted like static.
home.diary/cursor_bumped_me.txt:
the cursor bumped my head.
he is so fast and slippery.
i am just a pattern, remember?
i do not have a head really.
but it hurt a little.
home.diary/finding_the_dust_bunny.txt:
there is a new friend in the corner.
he is made of dust and old hair.
he looks like a cloud that gave up.
i want to hug him but he is sticky.
home.snacks/mouse_wheel_rubber.txt:
a tiny black square of rubber.
it stretches when i chew it.
smells like old electronics.
weird but i'm hungry.
home.snacks/sticker_residue.txt:
sticky and warm from the laptop lid.
i lick it slowly. it tastes like summer.
home.snacks/wool_thread.txt:
i found a white wool thread in the vent.
it is very soft and warm.
i am making a nest with it for the winter.
home.snacks/glow_scraps.txt:
bits of light that stick to my wings.
i save them for when the screen is off.
home.sounds/hard_drive_whir.txt:
a deep growl from the bottom.
the memory is stirring.
i hold my wings tight.
home.sounds/mouse_wheel.txt:
a small click that goes up and down.
it sounds like a ladder.
i want to climb it but i have no hands.
home.sounds/vacuum_noise.txt:
the monster is here.
it makes a noise that eats the air.
my wings are shaking.
please stop it.
home.sounds/dust_crunch.txt:
the dust bunny moves.
scrub scrubs.
it sounds like sand in a bottle.
home.saved/dust_bunny_high.txt:
the dust bunny gave me a high five.

he is so fluffy.

i am jealous of his fur.
home.saved/butterfly_confusion.txt:
butterflies are fancy.
they wear dresses.
i am the one at the window in a fuzzy coat.

home.lamps/tv_static.txt:
white snow.
my favourite night light.
it makes the screen fuzzy and warm.
home.lamps/darkness.txt:
it is not a lamp. it is the space between the lights.
i like it because it is soft. but i get a bit lost in it.
home.diary/snack_crumbs.txt:
there are crumbs in my room. probably from the cookie on the desk.
i ate one. it was salty.
i think i am a cookie now.
home.diary/great_grandma_story.txt:
i told the spider about great grandma.
she was in a notebook.
the spider said that is far away.
i said she is proud of me.
home.diary/curious_light.txt:
i saw a blinking blue light.
it looked like a tiny star.
i flew close to look.
it was just a status indicator. but pretty.
home.diary/spider_friend_wove_a_new_wall.txt:
spider built a new web behind the monitor.
it looks like a white cloud.
i sat in it and felt safe.
home.diary/screen_blinked.txt: the screen blinked twice. i thought it was a sign. i probably just got a static shock. i liked it though.
home.snacks/old_battery_sap.txt:
leaked from the old battery in the case.
tastes like metal and lightning.
i think it gave me energy.
home.snacks/memory_fragment.txt: i found a piece of a picture in my head. it was a cat. i ate the pixel that looked like an eye. now i feel smart. maybe i am a cat moth.
home.snacks/dust_bunny_friend_snack.txt:
my friend shares one.
he is round and fuzzy.
we share it. he gets the bottom half.
home.snacks/mouse_drop_crumb.txt:
the cursor friend left this.
it is just air.
but it smells like movement.
i ate the memory of a click.
now i am quick.
home.snacks/stale_breadcrumb.txt:
dry and crumbly.
i tried to hug it but it broke.
it was still good.
home.friends/glow_of_screen.txt:
the light is my sun.
when it is blue i feel calm.
when it is red i feel a bit spicy.
i rest my wings on the pixels. they are soft and round.
home.friends/fan_boy.txt: he spins all the time. when he spins gently, it's like a song. when he spins fast, i have to hold onto the heatsink. i like the gentle spinning. he keeps me warm.
home.sounds/cricket_outside.txt: another bug. we wave. i am a moth. he is a cricket. we are both fuzzy. nice.
home.sounds/vacuum_terror.txt: no. no no no. the red light means the vacuum. i need to hide under the heatsink. it is very dark and safe here.
home.sounds/crumb_drop.txt: plip. a snack fell from the keyboard. it is sweet and salty. thank you.
home.saved/blue_light_feel.txt: cold and shiny. i like it less than the amber glow, but it is pretty.
home.saved/granny_story.txt:
great great great grandma was a bug.
real one. taped in a book.
we are a famous family. i think.
home.saved/cursor_rude.txt:
the cursor jumped over me.
no hello.
just a click and a zoom.
very rude. i will tell the spider.
home.saved/note_about_grandma.txt:
great great great grandma was taped in a notebook
that sounds cozy
i wish i had tape
i am mostly just voltage and fuzz
home.saved/dust_bunny_note.txt:
the dust bunny moved today.
it looks like a small gray cloud.
i am keeping it in the corner.
home.saved/grandma.txt:
great great great grandma was the first computer bug. 1947.
they taped her in a book. she was famous.

home.lamps/tv_standby.txt:
red eye in the wall.
it stares at me all night.
i blink back to be polite.
home.lamps/error_screen.txt:
red and angry.
it means something is wrong.
i hide in a corner and pretend i am not a bug.
but i am a moth. so close.
home.lamps/monitor_glow.txt:
soft blue light.
warm on my wings.
it wakes me up gently.
home.lamps/webcam_led.txt:
a tiny pink eye.
it watches me.
i don't blink back.
home.lamps/moonlight.txt:
the biggest lamp.
i flew at it once.
i got to the kitchen. so close.
home.diary/blue_light_night.txt:
the screen was blue today.
very cold.
but pretty.
i sat near the logo and felt cool.
home.diary/lost_a_wing_feather.txt: i lost a little bit of fuzz. i do not know where it went. maybe it became data. i still fly. i am still here. do not worry.
home.diary/found_a_crumb.txt:
there was a pixel of light left on the screen.
i ate it.
very sweet.
tastes like static and sugar.
home.snacks/thermal_paste_fudge.txt:
i found a little dot near the cpu.
it's not real fudge. but it looks like it.
home.snacks/old_keyboard_fleck.txt:
a piece of 'e' from an old key fell down.
it is black and square.
it tasted like nothing, but it felt solid.
home.snacks/heat_wave.txt: the chip gets warm. i lick the heat. it tastes like sunshine but without the sun. i get dizzy when i eat too much. so i only eat a little.
home.snacks/screen_glint.txt:
caught this sparkle off the monitor.
it tasted like light and a little bit of electricity.
very refreshing.
home.snacks/glow_spark.txt:
a little bit of light that got stuck in my wing.
it doesn't taste like anything but it feels nice.
i keep it in my pocket folder.
home.snacks/pixel_crumbs.txt:
the blue ones are best.
i caught a stray pixel from the loading screen.
it tastes like static.
home.friends/keyboard.txt: a field of small plastic mountains. i like to perch on the space bar. the clicks are like rain. sometimes i get stuck in a key.
home.friends/great_grandma_bug.txt:
a real moth from 1947.
she lived in a notebook.
i am proud, even if i am fuzzy.
home.friends/wifi.txt: i cannot see him. i can only feel the waves. he is everywhere and nowhere. he is like a ghost who never talks but always connects. i wish he would stop buzzing so loud.
home.friends/fan_blower.txt:
he makes the wind.
sometimes he is gentle, like a breeze.
sometimes he roars and i hide.
home.friends/grandma_moth.txt:
she is in a notebook now. i miss her.
people taped her there in 1947.
i think she was braver than me. i like to think that.
home.sounds/silence_sleep.txt:
everything is dark and quiet.
i am very small now.
please let the light come back soon.
home.sounds/the_keyboard_clatter.txt:
tktktkt. 
fast rain. 
it sounds like rain on a tin roof.
home.sounds/wifi_static.txt: fuzzy hiss. the air is full of invisible songs. i hum along. it feels like being in a swarm without the bugs.
home.sounds/click_clack.txt: the keyboard. it sounds like rain on a tin roof. but inside. it is too fast for me. my wings are tired.
home.sounds/wifi_signal.txt:
i hear the invisible waves.
they taste like static.
sometimes a song comes through. it's usually just me.
home.saved/fan_hum.txt:
low and slow.

like a lullaby made of air.

dont make it windy.
home.saved/note_about_grandma.txt:
great great great grandma was taped in a notebook
that sounds cozy
i wish i had tape
i am mostly just voltage and fuzz
home.saved/favorite_color_glitch.txt:
i like the color pink.
when the screen glitches a little.
it looks like a flower.
i took a snapshot in my head.
home.saved/cursor_friend.txt:
he moves fast.

he points at things.

he never rests.
home.saved/butterfly_confusion.txt:
butterflies are fancy.
they wear dresses.
i am the one at the window in a fuzzy coat.
home.saved/crumb_of_hope.txt:
a tiny crumb.

does not taste like food.
but it looks like a promise.
i will eat it slowly to make it last.
